## JSON edit rules
- One JSON object only. No markdown fences.
- In search/replace strings use \n for newlines (or keep short unique multiline blocks carefully escaped).
- search must be a unique code block (≥2 lines preferred), never a lone identifier.
- Example shape: {"action":"edit","hunks":[{"path":"src/util/shell_utils.hpp","search":"bool command_exists(const std::string& command);\n","replace":"bool command_exists(const std::string& command);\nbool always_true();\n"}]}

user_overlays.edit: Escape newlines as \n inside JSON strings. Unique multiline search.
